|errata_history=[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998): entry “Blast The Door, Kid! — If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force to exclude from that battle all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides).” Its preface makes revised text the correct gameplay text for all versions of a card; the entry is not labelled “Errata”. Decipher had already printed these words on the white-border [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Revised)]] (Revised A New Hope, September 1998). The [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002) repeats the text and adds: “Characters of ability > 2 or leaders introduced to the battle after this Interrupt has been played are also immediately excluded from the battle.” Print: “After a battle at an interior site is initiated, use 1 Force to cause all leaders and all characters with ability > 2 (on both sides) to be completely excluded from that battle.” Superseded by the Players Committee wording: see [[Blast The Door, Kid! (PC Errata)]].
|notes=* Image: [[:File:ANH-L-blastthedoorkid-pc2007.gif]], the Players Committee's 2007 card-gallery image of the black-border card with this wording (bronze errata disc at the bottom right). The white-border [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Revised)]] prints the same words.
* The Japanese printing ([[Blast The Door, Kid! (Japanese)]], September 1997) predates this text.
* Side-by-side faces: [[Errata#Decipher and PC Errata|Errata — Decipher and PC Errata]].
